product.name: Olympiad Learning
product.description: A responsive learning platform for teenagers preparing for academic Olympiads with guided lessons, practice quizzes, spaced review, progress dashboards, and searchable problem sets.
product.primary_task: learn difficult concepts and practice problems repeatedly

goals: Make difficult material feel approachable without making the product childish.
Keep learning content and progress more prominent than decorative UI.

require: Keep learning content visually dominant over rewards, decoration, and navigation chrome.
avoid: Do not turn every lesson, metric, or section into a separate rounded card.
